verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and an MCP integration, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The click-tracking feature tracks email subscribers, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
